insights.finding: Best: power-protector 'mistake' reel (reach 234, 5 saves, 3 shares, view rate 43.9%, avg watch 8.4s). Weakest: Aura Studio article reel (reach 41, view rate 30%, avg watch 4.7s). Carousels reached 94-157.
insights.apply: Prefer problem/mistake hooks tied to a household or car need («X رو اشتباه نخر», «کدوم X برای کدوم ...») over plain comparisons; first frame must state the problem; keep reels ~15s.

style_rule: From 2026-10-31 (Mohammad's request): every reel/post is rendered with tools/studio.py — the light story look (logo, gradient pills, white cards, Vazirmatn) + cinematic motion (kinetic type, paper-wipe transitions, camera push, products sliding in and floating).
